description: Invent a brand-new voice from a written description instead of cloning a real person: no consent needed and nobody owns it. Describe who they are, how old they sound, their accent, their pace and their feeling, in 20 to 1000 characters, for example "a woman in her thirties, warm low London accent, unhurried, close and conversational like a late night radio host". Optionally add sample_text (100 to 1000 characters) for the line you want to hear it read, or leave it out and one is written for you. The voice is saved to your voice list and the sample line is saved as audio. Costs tokens (a charge applies). Returns voice_id and an audio_url of the sample.

description.description: 20 to 1000 characters describing the voice: age, accent, pace, tone, the feeling it gives.

name.description: What to call this voice in the library, e.g. "Gravel, late night radio".

sample_text.description: Optional. 100 to 1000 characters for the voice to read in the sample. Leave out and one is written for you.
